title: Faros Platform: Engineering Intelligence & Productivity

hero.headline: Discover the power of the Faros platform
hero.subhead: From visibility to control, Faros powers the productivity initiatives of the world's largest engineering organizations.

sections.heading: What's under the hood? Six powerful capabilities
sections.body: Foundational capabilities orgs with thousands of developers and coding agents need to maximize productivity in the age of AI.

sections.heading: Built for the enterprise
sections.body: Deploy quickly (days not months), scale to thousands of engineers, maintain compliance, safeguard data with granular access control. Key features: large-scale data infrastructure, customizable RBAC permissions, compliance/trust, secure deployment (SaaS, hybrid, on-prem).

sections.heading: Analytics that baseline and benchmark
sections.body: Unify engineering data with no pre-standardization. Key features: unified data model, intelligent attribution (map work to teams/services), process analytics (Lead Time, Resolution Time), benchmarks and heatmaps.

sections.heading: AI that guides and recommends
sections.body: Purpose-built AI for developer productivity. Key features: AI summaries and guidance, root cause analysis, expert chatbot (Slack/Teams/IDE), human vs. GenAI code analysis.

sections.heading: Interoperability for complete context
sections.body: Integrate the entire toolchain, cloud or on-prem, off-the-shelf or custom. Key features: high-performance connectors, flexible ingestion (Cloud Connectors, Source CLI, Events CLI), webhooks/APIs, any-source compatibility.

sections.heading: Customization to reflect how you build
sections.body: Custom metrics, fully custom dashboards, natural language assistant, workflow builder automations.

sections.heading: Catalogs for teams and services
sections.body: A single navigable source of truth: org chart management, service catalog, team pages, IDP integrations.

sections.heading: Problems we solve
sections.body: Run engineering faster with AI that knows how you design, implement, test, and ship product.

sections.heading: Pricing note (from page FAQ)
sections.body: Paid platform; pricing stated 'from as low as $29 per contributor per module per month' (FAQ/LLM-optimization block, contact sales for quotes).

stats.label: per contributor per module per month (stated floor)
